mentions.name: Bulletproof home-cooking recipe app (unnamed)
mentions.description: This recipe app offers bulletproof, easy-to-follow recipes and smart features that make cooking simple, aiming to give home cooks the knowledge of an experienced cook so they can make good food quickly, cheaply, and easily without years of learning. After four years of development and five rebuilds, the core recipe functionality technically solves the author's cooking problems; the author is now filling it with data and polishing usability ahead of a planned 2026 launch, starting with a deliberately small UI that will grow based on feedback from recipe creators and end users.
mentions.problem: Good food at home is complicated and time consuming, and the author found that even the best of over 50 existing recipe apps solved only about half of their cooking issues; technical complexity is why no other app could solve them.
mentions.audience: Everyone deserves good food at home, but good food is complicated and time consuming
mentions.source_excerpt: It is a recipe app but better, and way more technically capable than anything out there. The goal is to make the best recipe app ever made. With bulletproof easy to follow recipes and smart features to make cooking simple.

evidence.value: It is a recipe app but better, and way more technically capable than anything out there. The goal is to make the best recipe app ever made. With bulletproof easy to follow recipes and smart features to make cooking simple.
